name: msfs-a320-copilot
description: Read-only FlyByWire A320 telemetry, left MCDU and guided simulator checklists on Windows x64. Downloads the pinned runtime on first start; Real mode requires local SimConnect configuration.

interface.longDescription: Windows x64 only. Reads SimConnect aircraft telemetry and the left MCDU through SimBridge, and stores training checklist progress. Starts in a clearly labeled Mock mode until Real is configured. The first MCP start downloads a pinned GitHub release and verifies its SHA-256. No aircraft commands are sent.
defaultPrompt: Configure o copiloto para meu FlyByWire A320.
